title: Read the test outcomes
statement: The test outcomes MUST be read from the test runners' own machine-readable output, go test -json for Go and the unittest result for Python, keyed by the lathe ID each test carries in its name; a test whose name carries no ID gives no outcome, and the outcomes are ordered by test record ID.

title: Measure the coverage
statement: The coverage at a commit MUST be read from lathe check on that commit's tree alone, summed over every domain and obligation kind, so two readings of the same commit agree.

title: Verify an attestation
statement: An attestation MUST be fetched from the provider by the commit it is about and accepted only when its signature, signer identity, subject and predicate type all check; any failure yields no attestation, never a partial one.

title: Write the SBOMs
statement: The SBOMs MUST be written from the build record's module inventory alone, in SPDX and in CycloneDX, in a fixed order, so the same record always gives the same files.

title: Check an artifact against its record
statement: An executable, a source snapshot or an image MUST be accepted only when every digest its trusted record names matches it exactly.

title: Derive the requirements
statement: The platform requirements MUST be derived from the declaration and the needs its components state alone, in a fixed order, so the same declaration always gives the same file.

title: Check an environment against the requirements
statement: An environment file MUST be accepted only when every platform requirement is met and every value is of the type the environment schema states, such as an image named by digest.

title: Fill digest
statement: The digest of a fill MUST be computed from every file in its folder in a fixed order, with fill.yaml's evidence and sign-off left out, so recording evidence or a signature never changes it. A slot contract's digest MUST be computed from the slot's .proto file alone.

title: Verify a sign-off
statement: A sign-off MUST be accepted only when its signature verifies, with ssh-keygen -Y verify or gpg --verify, over exactly the digest of the fill's current evidence, by a key that the project's SIGNERS file lists.

title: Component digest
statement: The digest of one component MUST be computed from that component's files in the registry alone, in a fixed order, so the same content always gives the same digest and a change to another component never changes it.

title: Run a component's generator
statement: A component's generator MUST receive only the component's resolved configuration and the inputs the compiler captured, and MUST return the same files and wiring for the same inputs.

title: Assemble the service
statement: The assembler MUST combine every generator's wiring into the service's entry point and module file, where the module file requires the runtime library at the archetype's pin, and the same wirings MUST give the same files.

title: Derive the architecture model
statement: The architecture model MUST be derived from the declaration, the registry parts and the assembler's wiring alone, in a fixed order, and MUST hold the service's structure (components, ports, adapters, slots and the fills bound to them), its data model (entities, fields, references, collections and operations), its request flows (from each endpoint through authentication, handler, slot, repository and store to the events it raises) and its platform edges (each need in platform-requirements.yaml), so the same inputs always give the same model.
